confirmedRules.name: Decimal point is comma
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: COBOL uses European decimal comma for numeric literals and edited pictures across H/K/L and helpers.
confirmedRules.given: Any module with Special-Names Decimal-Point Is Comma

confirmedRules.name: H invokes K then L in sequence
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: H-module performs C000-Call-K-Module then D000-Call-L-Module on every main path.
confirmedRules.then: FTFCK110 is called then FTFCL110 with STG header, L-Input, and R7919999-Error
edgeCases: K/L failures surface via S000-Status-Code; L is still invoked after K returns

confirmedRules.name: K mandatory envelope fields
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: K rejects missing Fin-Inst-No, Contract-Type, Contract-No, Last-Saved-Date, or Operation-Type when respective *-I flags are not 'U'.
confirmedRules.when: A required RTFCE110 input indicator is not 'U' but field is absent

confirmedRules.name: Selected party requires type
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When a party row is selected (Selected-D = Y) but Type-I is not 'U', K raises TF-SY-TYPE-MISSING.
confirmedRules.when: RTFCE110-I-Selected-I = 'U' and Type-I not 'U' and Selected-D = 'Y'

confirmedRules.name: K-module initial check calls F115L050
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: K initializes R115L050-Initial-Check from header/function data and CALLs F115L050.
confirmedRules.then: F115L050 is called with R115L050-Initial-Check and R7919999-Error

confirmedRules.name: K propagates F115L050 errors
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: After F115L050, K maps Return-Abend to Z900-Abend and Return-Error to Z700-Error-AE with FM message code.

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 requires function and medium
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Initial check abends if Function or Medium is spaces.

confirmedRules.name: Invalid status and operation-type combination
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: F115L050 rejects invalid STATUS to OPERATION-TYPE relation from F115ISR0.
confirmedRules.when: F115ISR0 returns Return-Error for VALID-ST-OP relation
confirmedRules.then: TF-SY-INVALID-STATUS-OPERTYP with VAR1/VAR2; paragraph F102; Z700-Error-AE

confirmedRules.name: Permanent status blocks in-progress main contract
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When status is permanent and main contract is in-progress, initial check errors unless Function is TFD05.
confirmedRules.when: Ws-Code-Count > 0 and R115IMC0-In-Progress-Yes and Function not TFD05

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 PA-Seq-No zero skips amount reads
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When PA-Seq-No is zero, status comes from main contract only; contract/part amount reads are skipped.

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 main-contract table version ACTUAL vs WORK
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Initial check reads main contract ACTUAL first; if in-progress, re-reads using WORK table version.

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 skips property check for READ and SHOW
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: When Function third char is R and Operation-Type is SHOW, G000-Check-Properties is skipped.

confirmedRules.name: L-module status not unique
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: L-module raises TF-SY-STATUS-NOT-UNIQUE when status lookup is ambiguous.
confirmedRules.smeQuestion: Confirm exact branch predicate in FTFCL110 surrounding line 253.

confirmedRules.name: L-module no party on contract
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: L-module raises TF-SY-NO-PART when required party row is missing.

confirmedRules.name: K calls find-currency helper F115L280
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: K-module invokes F115L280 for currency resolution using R115L280-Find-Currency.

confirmedRules.name: F115L050 update-timestamp check disabled on main path
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: E000-Check-Upd-Timestamp is commented out (July test change); do not enforce update timestamp on main path.
confirmedRules.smeQuestion: Confirm whether production mainframe re-enabled this block.

confirmedRules.name: H-module must not be hand-edited
confirmedRules.plainEnglish: Module header states THIS MODULE MUST NOT BE MODIFIED BY HUMAN HANDS.
confirmedRules.then: Regenerate from Servo tooling rather than hand-edit
